content.text: {"label":"outage","confidence":"high","explanation":"Payments calls jumped to 169 and 175 in the 11:45 and 12:00 intervals, against about 108 forecast each (+55% and +62%). Over the same hour, card_declined calls ran at 181 against 61 expected (2.96x normal), which accounts for nearly all of the excess, while other call reasons stayed close to normal.
